Cooking game: the new pieces

Every piece of the kids’ cooking game, redrawn in one richer “real game” style: a warm kitchen, chunky outlines, shiny steel, glossy food. Each piece is separate and reusable, so any dish can be built from the same kit: chop on the board, cook in the pot or pan, bake in the oven, serve in the bowl.

All of it is original Healthy Steps art, drawn as code (no image files), so it stays sharp on any screen and loads instantly.

1The kitchen and the counter

The backdrop behind every dish, and the wooden counter everything sits on.

2Cooking stations

Where the action happens. One station per kind of step: chop, boil, fry, bake, mix.

3Serving dishes

What the finished food goes into. The child’s arrangement stays in the dish to the end.

4Ingredient containers

Steel trays and little bowls that hold the ingredients along the bottom of the screen, within thumb reach.

5Ingredients and how they change

Each food has a look for every stage, so chopping, mashing and cooking visibly change it.

6Tools

7Game interface pieces

The order card (what the dish needs, ticked off as it’s added), the heat meter and the buttons.

8All together

How the pieces combine on a phone. Same kit, two different dishes and step types.
